Our 9-Tier over the door pantry organizer is designed to make the most of your storage space, allowing you to store more items in a smaller area such as spice and some jars. Perfect for small kitchens or those with limited storage space.

Durable & Strong: Made with high-quality, durable metal, our pantry organization can withstand the weight of heavy cans and jars, keeping your items secure and preventing them from falling off. It’s your home organization and kitchen essentials. Please note: Measure your door to see if it fits the size of this product before choosing it, otherwise the door will not close.

Quick & Easy Installation: No tools or drilling are required to install our pantry organizer over the door. This makes it a hassle-free storage solution that won't damage your walls or doors. If you can't close the door after use, you can rip off the foam under the hook and close it.

Versatile & Multi-functional: Not just for storage pantry items, our organizer can be used to store a variety of household items such as cleaning supplies, toiletries, and shoes. This makes it a versatile storage solution for any room in your home.
